system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 30 minutes, 5 Spell Uses. Lasts: 30 minutes. An incredibly juvenile spell that fills the area with thick, foul-smelling fog that makes it impossible to see. Useful for thieves and pranksters. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
